title: Beyond Easy Clients: Difficulty- and Improvement-Aware Aggregation for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Robot Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25637v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated reinforcement learning enables a fleet of robots to jointly learn a shared navigation policy without exchanging raw experience. In practice, however, the robots rarely operate in the same conditions: an open aisle is far easier to navigate than a cluttered room, and takes less learning to master. Standard federated aggregation rules ignore this. Uniform averaging weights every client equally, whether or not it is still learning, and weighting by episode return is worse, since easy environments permit high returns by construction. Both failures stem from what we call the \emph{plateau problem}: once a client masters its environment, its updates carry little new information even though its reported return remains high. We propose \emph{FedDIA}, which scores each client by how much its local training improves the global model it received, amplified by the difficulty of its environment. translated_title: 超越简单客户端：面向机器人导航的联邦强化学习中难度与改进感知的聚合方法
translated_abstract: 联邦强化学习使一群机器人能够共同学习一个共享的导航策略，而无需交换原始经验数据。然而在实践中，机器人很少在相同的条件下运行：开阔的过道远比杂乱的房间容易导航，掌握起来所需的学习也更少。标准的联邦聚合规则忽略了这一点。均匀平均对所有客户端赋予相同的权重，无论其是否仍在学习过程中；而按回合回报加权则效果更差，因为简单环境天然就能产生高回报。这两种失败都源于我们所谓的“平台期问题”：一旦某个客户端掌握了其所处的环境，即便其报告的回报依然很高，其更新也几乎不再携带新的信息。我们提出了FedDIA，该方法根据每个客户端的本地训练对所接收到的全局模型的改进程度来为其评分，并结合其环境难度进行放大。难度是从模型自身……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出FedDIA聚合方法，根据客户端本地训练对全局模型的改进程度并结合环境难度进行加权聚合，解决了联邦强化学习中“平台期问题”——即已掌握简单环境的客户端仍以高回报获得不当权重的问题。
en_tdlr: FedDIA is a difficulty- and improvement-aware federated aggregation method for robot navigation that weights clients by how much their local training improves the global model, amplified by environment difficulty, thereby overcoming the plateau problem where easy clients contribute little new information.
